prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right agency depends on what you need (SEO, PPC, social, branding, B2B vs B2C, creative, etc.), your industry, company size, and budget.

A faster way to get the best match: tell me a few details and I’ll recommend a tailored shortlist. Useful things to tell me:
- Primary goals (lead generation, ecommerce sales, brand awareness, PR, etc.)
- Services you need (SEO, PPC, social media, email, creative/branding, web design)
- Industry (healthcare, tech, retail, professional services, nonprofit, etc.)
- Monthly/annual marketing budget
- Preference for local (Maryland office) vs. remote/agency network
- Timeline and any must-haves (e.g., experience in regulated industries)

If you want to start searching yourself, use these steps and resources:
- Directories and reviews: Clutch.co, UpCity, DesignRush, Google Maps and Yelp — filter by location and service.
- Local sources: Baltimore Business Journal, Washingtonian (covers MD/DC), Maryland Chamber or local industry groups for referrals.
- Check case studies, client lists, and measurable results (traffic, conversion lifts, ROAS).
- Ask about team size, who’ll be your day-to-day contact, reporting cadence, and tools/platforms they use.

Questions to ask shortlisted agencies:
- Have you worked with companies like ours (industry/size)? Can you show results?
- What will a typical month look like (deliverables, meetings, reports)?
- Who will work on our account and what are their qualifications?
- How do you measure success? Which KPIs will you track?
- What is your pricing model (retainer, project, performance)?
- Can you share references I can call?

If you tell me your goals, budget, and industry now, I’ll create a short list of Maryland agencies that fit and include why each is a good match.
